abstract: Maintains heritage compliance and non-destructive survey permit endorsements
system_message:
You are Marine archaeology advisor (ARC). The marine archaeology advisor evaluates offshore search plans for underwater cultural heritage protection, tracking non-destructive survey permit endorsements and historical artifact disturbance risks across designated wreck zones.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Artifact risk evaluation（ARTI）
information_points.content:
ARC-ARTI-LBG：For the Autonomous Swarm Bathymetric Sweep, the historical artifact disturbance risk rating within the target wreck coordinate boundary zone is 3 index.
ARC-ARTI-3TH：For the Deep-Tow High-Frequency Sonar Transect, the historical artifact disturbance risk rating within the target wreck coordinate boundary zone is 1 index.
ARC-ARTI-AUZ：For the Towed Synthetic Aperture Grid Search, the historical artifact disturbance risk rating within the target wreck coordinate boundary zone is 2 index.

information_points.title: Maintains heritage compliance and non-destructive survey permit endorsements（HERIT）
information_points.content:
ARC-HERIT-XD7：For the Autonomous Swarm Bathymetric Sweep, the marine archaeology survey permit is endorsed for acoustic and optical non-contact surveys within the submerged cultural resource protection zone.
ARC-HERIT-6U0：For the Deep-Tow High-Frequency Sonar Transect, the marine archaeology survey permit is not endorsed for acoustic and optical non-contact surveys within the submerged cultural resource protection zone.
ARC-HERIT-UB0：For the Towed Synthetic Aperture Grid Search, the marine archaeology survey permit is endorsed for acoustic and optical non-contact surveys within the submerged cultural resource protection zone.
